title: IndustReal assembly · AR-aligned detectable parts
note: Parts are the physical objects SAM3 should search for on 03_assy_0_1. Vocabulary follows IndustReal AR object nouns (not eval CSVs). partial model is the in-progress assembly body (do not also search chassis base/front/rear chassis). Detection may further restrict to ready∪current∪next step parts at runtime. hand/paper are station context.

steps.instruction: Install the front chassis by fitting the two short braces to opposite sides of the partial model.
steps.completion_check: Both short braces are attached on opposite sides of the partial model.
steps.recovery: Hold the procedure and request supervisor review; no unapproved automatic correction is prescribed.

steps.instruction: Install the front chassis pin through the partial model and fit retaining hardware: tooth lock washer, then hex nut (tighten).
steps.completion_check: The short metal pin is located through the partial model with tooth lock washer and hex nut fitted.
steps.recovery: Hold the procedure and request supervisor review; no unapproved automatic correction is prescribed.

steps.instruction: Install the rear chassis by fitting the two long braces to opposite sides of the partial model.
steps.completion_check: Both long braces are positioned on opposite sides of the partial model.
steps.recovery: Hold the procedure and request supervisor review; no unapproved automatic correction is prescribed.

steps.instruction: Install the front rear-chassis pin and fit retaining hardware: tooth lock washer, then hex nut (tighten).
steps.completion_check: The short metal pin is located at the front joint of the rear chassis with tooth lock washer and hex nut fitted.
steps.recovery: Hold the procedure and request supervisor review; no unapproved automatic correction is prescribed.

steps.instruction: Install the rear rear-chassis pin and fit retaining hardware: tooth lock washer, then hex nut (tighten).
steps.completion_check: The short metal pin is located at the rear joint of the rear chassis with tooth lock washer and hex nut fitted.
steps.recovery: Hold the procedure and request supervisor review; no unapproved automatic correction is prescribed.

steps.instruction: Install the white front bracket on the partial model.
steps.completion_check: The white front bracket is correctly located on the partial model.
steps.recovery: Hold the procedure and request supervisor review; no unapproved automatic correction is prescribed.

steps.instruction: Install the front bracket screw pin through the front bracket and fit round flat washer then acorn nut (tighten).
steps.completion_check: The screw pin is located through the front bracket with round flat washer and acorn nut fitted.
steps.recovery: Hold the procedure and request supervisor review; no unapproved automatic correction is prescribed.

steps.instruction: Install the front wheel at the front bracket using the connection hardware.
steps.completion_check: The front wheel is correctly located at the front bracket.
steps.recovery: Stop. Finish IR24 (front bracket screw) before installing the front wheel, then request supervisor review if the station state is unclear.

steps.instruction: Install the rear wheel assembly (wheel, pulley, wing) on the partial model using the connection hardware.
steps.completion_check: The rear wheel assembly is correctly located on the partial model.
steps.recovery: Stop. Confirm the rear-chassis branch (IR09/IR15/IR18) is finished before installing the rear wheel assembly, then request supervisor review if unsure.
